hooks.command: file=$(echo $TOOL_INPUT | jq -r '.file_path // .filePath // empty'); if [ -n "$file" ] && echo "$file" | grep -qE '\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx)$'; then npx prettier --write "$file" 2>/dev/null; fi

cmd=$(echo $TOOL_INPUT | jq -r '.command // empty'); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE 'git\s+(push\s+--force|reset\s+--hard|clean\s+-f|checkout\s+\.|restore\s+\.)'; then echo 'BLOCKED: destructive git command requires CTO approval' >&2; exit 2; fi

if [ -z "$GORP_AGENT" ] || [ -z "$GORP_SCOPE" ]; then exit 0; fi; file=$(echo $TOOL_INPUT | jq -r '.file_path // .filePath // empty'); if [ -z "$file" ]; then exit 0; fi; if echo "$file" | grep -q '.gorp/journal/'; then exit 0; fi; if echo "$file" | grep -q '.gorp/plans/current-sprint.md'; then exit 0; fi; IFS=',' read -ra PATTERNS <<< "$GORP_SCOPE"; for pattern in "${PATTERNS[@]}"; do if echo "$file" | grep -q "^$pattern\|/$pattern"; then exit 0; fi; done; echo "BLOCKED: agent '$GORP_AGENT' cannot edit '$file' — outside declared scope ($GORP_SCOPE)" >&2; exit 2
